candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The station is defined as a material aggregate of physical railway facilities, and BFO_0000040 is material entity.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: It may more specifically be an object aggregate, which is still under material entity.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: A train composed of rail vehicles is a material continuant, so subclass of BFO_0000040 is appropriate.
